title: Reproducibility archive: Patient-Grouped Deep Learning for ECG Beat Classification: Explainability Components and External Evaluation on INCART
description: Frozen protocol, fold assignments, scripts, per-beat out-of-fold (MIT-BIH) and external (INCART) predictions, result manifests, verification outputs, model checkpoints and figure/table generation scripts accompanying the article "Patient-Grouped Deep Learning for ECG Beat Classification: Explainability Components and External Evaluation on INCART". Source ECG databases are not redistributed; see data_access/DATA_ACCESS.md. Third-party materials are listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
